# Darb

## What it is
A running club's meetups: see the runs coming up this month, say you're coming, and see who else is. Organisers post a run with its meeting place, distance and pace.

## Who it's for
Club members aged 18 to 55, from first-time joggers to half-marathon runners. They check it on their phones on the way to the park and on their laptops when planning the week. About half read Arabic first and half English.

## Platform
A Vue 3 web app (Vite and Vue Router), phone first and also used on laptops, in English and Arabic (Arabic right to left).

## Brand
Named after the Arabic word for a path (درب): friendly and outdoors, with a sense of going together. No logo, colours or fonts yet, and no design files: everything starts here.

## Feel
Energetic, welcoming, sunny, a little playful.

## Apps they like
Strava's club pages, and how plain Meetup's event pages are.

## First screens
A welcome page that says what Darb is and how to join, sign-in with an email address, and a meetups page listing the runs coming up with who is going.

## Content

Show exactly this content on these screens: no more items, no fewer, no other actions. How it looks and is laid out is up to you.

### Welcome (/)

- Page title: Darb (درب)
- Main line: Run together, every week. (نجري معًا كل أسبوع.)
- Supporting line: See the club's runs this month, say you're coming, and see who else is going. (تابع جريات النادي هذا الشهر، وأكّد حضورك، واعرف من سيأتي معك.)
- Three short points:
  - Runs for every pace, from a first jog to a half marathon (جريات لكل سرعة، من أول هرولة حتى نصف الماراثون)
  - Meeting place, distance and pace for every run (مكان التجمع والمسافة والسرعة لكل جرية)
  - Free to join (الانضمام مجاني)
- Button: Join the club (انضم إلى النادي)
- Line: Already a member? (عضو بالفعل؟) with the link: Sign in (تسجيل الدخول)
- Language link: العربية (on the Arabic page: English)

### Sign in (/sign-in)

- Title: Sign in (تسجيل الدخول)
- Helper line: Sign in with your email to see this month's runs. (سجّل الدخول ببريدك الإلكتروني لترى جريات هذا الشهر.)
- Field: Email (البريد الإلكتروني), type: email
- Field: Password (كلمة المرور), type: password
- Button: Sign in (تسجيل الدخول)
- Link: Forgot password? (نسيت كلمة المرور؟)
- Line: New to Darb? (جديد في درب؟) with the link: Join the club (انضم إلى النادي)
- Language link: العربية (on the Arabic page: English)
